authored.terrain_cover: Coarse palette chosen from aligned aerial pixels, not a land-cover or species classification product.
authored.water: Authored image-color threshold inside the mapped river footprint; DEM-following height plus 0.18 m rendering clearance. Interpolated boundaries, green color and moving highlights are visual choices, not measured level, flow, velocity, depth or inundation.
